findings.claim: Chipotle 8-K 揭露 FDA 與明尼蘇達衛生部調查與供應鏈相關的沙門氏菌疫情；明州機關無持續疑慮，問題追溯至單一批次墨西哥辣椒並已下架
findings.excerpt: We are aware that public health authorities such as the Food and Drug Administration and the Minnesota Department of Health are investigating the source of a salmonella outbreak in the supply chain impacting several food service retailers in Minnesota and other states.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 三次搜尋均未發現針對 CMG 的反壟斷、拆分或 DOJ/FTC/EU 競爭調查。僅見 2026-08 食安（沙門氏菌）FDA／明尼蘇達衛生部調查及 10-K 所述勞動法規審計，屬一般營運監管而非反壟斷。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
